subject: Request: add analytics processing partner (CloudBridge)
messages:
From: Sasha Kaplan <sasha.kaplan@finservinc.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: partner-ops@cloudbridge.io
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: add CloudBridge as processing partner for analytics connector

Hi Soojin / Marissa,

Hope you’re both well. We’re evaluating a short integration with CloudBridge to run aggregated analytics over transaction metadata for a pilot with our risk team. CloudBridge would only process a subset of non-identifying metadata (transaction timestamps, merchant category codes, and hashed customer IDs) on our behalf.

Before we move forward we need Redwood to confirm:
- Whether CloudBridge can be engaged as a subprocessor under our DPA (i.e., onward transfer permission).
- Any required addendum or controls evidence (SOC 2 report, SIG or CAIQ responses, network segmentation details).

Attached is the partner’s short profile for your reference. Let us know if you need more detail from CloudBridge or if your privacy/legal team requires a redlined addendum. We’re aiming to have a signed PO out by mid-December, so a quick review would be appreciated.

Attachment: cloudbridge_subproc_profile.pdf (PDF, 850 KB)

Thanks,
Sasha Kaplan
Head of Procurement
FinServ Inc
Sasha.Kaplan@finservinc.com
+1 (415) 555-0137
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: add CloudBridge as processing partner for analytics connector

Hi Sasha —

Thanks for the details and the profile. Appreciated. Quick note on next steps from our side:
1) I’ve looped in Marissa (privacy/legal) and Diego (security) to assess whether we can grant onward transfer permission under the existing DPA or if we require a narrow addendum.
2) Please confirm the exact data fields CloudBridge will receive and retention period (we only saw high-level notes in the profile).
3) We’ll need either CloudBridge’s latest SOC 2 report (redacted is fine) or their completed SIG/CAIQ so Diego can validate controls.

For transparency, I’m attaching our current DPA reference so your legal team can see the clauses we typically require for subprocessors. If FinServ prefers, we can prepare a short one-page addendum that lists the permitted categories and approved subprocessors.

Attachment: redwood_dpa_v3.pdf (PDF, 1.1 MB)

Sooj

Hi all —

Quick security intake from my side after a brief look at the profile:
- Required evidence before approval: SOC 2 Type II (most recent), network segmentation description, data handling/retention policies. SIG or CAIQ acceptable if complete.
- Controls I’ll validate: encryption in transit and at rest, key management, access controls (least privilege), logging and monitoring (retention/alerting), and data deletion processes.

If FinServ can get us CloudBridge’s SOC 2 redaction + SIG, I’ll run it through our checklist. I’ve attached a simple logical dataflow and a segmentation matrix template that we use for partner reviews — please have CloudBridge fill the matrix where applicable.

Attachment: dataflow_diagram.png (PNG, 420 KB)
Attachment: segmentation_matrix.xlsx (Excel, 23 KB)

Diego Fernandez
Security Architect, Redwood Inference

If the materials look sufficient, FinServ is happy to sign your one-page addendum; CloudBridge is fine with the addendum and will execute via DocuSign.
